verdict.rationale: The Division runs online filing, search and retrieval services, so headless or CI-driven automation (an API, CLI or bulk programmatic access) is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence describes only interactive web portals, fax filing, email contact, and text/email notices, with nothing showing a headless or automatable interface. Notification alerts and the shared PBS payment account are adjacent features, not headless execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
